raw: Lorry, “I wouldn’t go on such an object without having some cause to believe that I should succeed.”
Lorry glanced at the distant House, and glanced at the angry Stryver.
“Here’s a man of business--a man of years--a man of experience--_in_ a Bank,” said Stryver;
“and having summed up three leading reasons for complete success, he says there’s no reason at all!
Says it with his head on!” Mr.
